Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa

* feat(design): tailwind 3.4 -> 4.3.1 via the official upgrade tool (purses-9oxh.6)

Quarantine-selected: 4.3.2 is 13 days old (one day inside the window);
4.3.1 (30d) pinned in the lockfile for tailwindcss + @tailwindcss/postcss
(the tool installs latest — pinned back deliberately). tailwind.config.ts
dissolves into globals.css @theme; the dark variant survives as
@custom-variant dark with :where() — zero specificity, source-order
semantics preserved (the tailwind-dark-selector-override trap checked
and clear). autoprefixer removed (v4 built-in); postcss.config.mjs is
the single @tailwindcss/postcss plugin. 34 template files migrated by
the tool; v4 border-color compat layer included. Build green.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa

* fix(design): app element rules into @layer base — the v4 cascade root cause

Under v3, utilities were UNLAYERED and beat the app's own `* {margin:0;
padding:0}` reset and `a {color}` rules by specificity. v4 layers
utilities, and ANY unlayered rule beats ANY layered one — so the reset
steamrolled every spacing utility and the anchor rule inked link-button
labels teal-on-teal (invisible). Diagnosed via in-capture computed-style
probes (h-11/max-w applied; px-4/mx-auto/text-white lost on the same
elements). Fix per the v4 upgrade guide: element rules wrapped in
@layer base; author CLASS rules (.prose-measure) deliberately stay
unlayered, preserving their v3 source-order power over utilities.
Post-fix pixel diff vs the tailwind-3 baseline (58 tablet shots, both
themes): 6 identical; every residual is (a) the translucent header's
color-mix-vs-rgba compositing under backdrop-blur or (b) <=32px rhythm
drift — masks in the PR. axe green both themes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa

* test(design): fold QA review — dark parser-honesty parity guard + primary-hover pairings

The light→dark spread let an unparseable dark var silently assert its
light value (false green strict() can't see). Key-set parity converts
truncation/oklch/second-block failures into hard reds. Plus the one
unguarded live text role (a:hover primary-hover) gets real pairings.
46 → 51 tests, all green.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa
